overall_summary: Analysis of 24 Shorts reveals strong audience engagement and retention around planetary-scale astrophysics and fundamental physics alters (e.g., 'Earth Had Rings Like Saturn' reaching 1,031 views and 51.26% avg view percentage). Micro-scale or invisible sensory scenarios (e.g., 'See Every Wi-Fi Signal' with 2 views) underperform significantly. High early retention curves (>1.0 audience watch ratio at start) correlate directly with overall view counts.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' generated 1,031 views, 51.26% average view percentage, and 1.33 initial audience watch ratio. 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 835 views.
what_is_working.action: Focus content production heavily on global, high-stakes astronomical and physics transformations.

what_is_working.pattern: High Initial Hook Intensity leading to Rewatches
what_is_working.evidence: Top performing video ('Earth Had Rings Like Saturn') achieved an audience watch ratio of 1.3353 at 1% progress, maintaining 0.4412 at 49% progress.
what_is_working.action: Maintain high visual impact in frames 0-2 to trigger immediate looping and rewatches.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' received 2 views; 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' generated only 19 views.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid abstract or non-visual hypothetical topics in favor of immediate dramatic visual changes.

what_to_improve.pattern: Immediate First-3-Second Drop-off on Pacing Flaws
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' dropped from 1.0513 watch ratio at 1% to 0.1220 at 5% progress, resulting in only 23.79% average view percentage.
what_to_improve.action: Deliver the core visual transformation within the first second to prevent initial scroll-away.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Immediate High-Impact Visual Hook (Earth Had Rings)
retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Strong hold zone starting above 1.0 watch ratio (1.3353 at 0.01 progress) and holding 0.4412 at 0.49 progress.
retention_insights.evidence: Average view percentage hit 51.26% with 31 seconds average view duration.
retention_insights.action: Replicate the immediate visual transformation layout used in the Saturn rings video across future Shorts.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Slow Visual Payoff (Rain at Speed of a Bullet)
retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Severe early drop off, plummeting to relative retention of 0.0494 at 0.23 progress.
retention_insights.evidence: Average view percentage reached only 23.79% with 14 seconds average view duration.
retention_insights.action: Shorten intro text/narration and show the action/consequence immediately upon video start.

best_posting_windows.reason: Top performer 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,031 views, 51.26% view percentage) was published at 04:56 UTC, and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (626 views) at 04:47 UTC.
'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 835 views when posted at 12:08 UTC.

1.style: Cinematic visual simulations of fundamental physical constants shifting.

avoid_or_limit.item: Abstract or invisible sensory alterations (e.g. Wi-Fi signals, chemical subtle shifts)
avoid_or_limit.reason: Low visual impact leads to near-zero views (2-19 views range).
Identical titles uploaded seconds apart show massive view suppression on the duplicate (e.g., 365 views vs 10 views).
